title: Question about making a backstory customized D&d game

posts.author: spades141
posts.body:
So im making a D&d Campaign into a game that me and my family is playing. and i want the player to be able to choice their own back story and it will come up again at some point. like how d&d ur character has a back story.
i thought about making like 3 options to pick from. how to i get the game to make these happen. lf they have an option of being noble or solider or Folk hero. and at the next quest i bring up something about their backstory. or should i just give them a backstory and let them just play as that character to keep it easy??

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
Depending on exactly what you want to do, you can easily do this with Event Commands or you can get more complex.
For a basic choose your background you can use Show Choices and then either set a Variable value based on the choice (1, 2, 3, etc.) or you could use unique Switches (each Switch relates to a background).
You can also set a Variable at the same time with a text String of the background, like "Noble", "Soldier", etc. and you can display that Variable whenever you want.
When it comes to quests or dialog that could vary based on background, you can have a simple Conditional Branch check and change things back on the background (Variable value or Switch that is ON).
None of that is too hard and uses simple Event Commands.
If you want something beyond that, if you give a more detailed explanation, I'm sure you can get some additional assistance.
I hope that helps and good luck on your projects!
